summary: REPAIR ROUND 8 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 7 -> 8, final round via user decision DEC-3bd11d4f796348c4a56095f8c673aa72, +25 min and +1 round). Fixed the SINGLE finding from independent review round 8, which was a comment/diagnostic scope error, and the reviewer had confirmed requirements=PASS, regression=PASS, performance=PASS with every functional property it could test holding and explicitly stated the round-7 code change must NOT be reverted. Changed ONLY src/stores/queueStore.ts (998 -> 1025 lines, +27); scope check reports outside=[] and protected=[]. THE FINDING: queueStore.ts:972-973 and :979 claimed that reaching the cap branch means candidates is non-empty so the warning text was a verified fact, and that a successful heal NEVER reports unreviewed - both invalid as universals, because collectQueuedMarkerCandidates (:896-907) selects nodes whose marker is TRUE, not nodes whose marker is STALE, while the predicate deliberately KEEPS legal markers (:931-932); so a single legal marker keeps the rescan permanently non-empty and drives the loop into the cap branch with the warning even when zero stale markers remain. Reviewer repro: a LEGAL node with a genuine queued job plus a stale node X re-armed 7 times gave passes=8, exit via cap, X already healed to false, LEGAL correctly kept true, yet 1 warning fired with zero stale markers left. FIX APPLIED (two hunks, both in the heal loop comment/cap block): (1) the never-reports claim is now explicitly SCOPED to the shape where the candidate set consists solely of stale markers, with the reason stated; (2) the verified-fact sentence was deleted and the console.warn is now GATED on a read-only stillClearable count (candidates whose marker is still true in flowStore AND which have no queued||running job, same nodeId scope as the predicate so no second scope convention is introduced), with wording that reports the count of still-clearable stale markers and states its own criterion inline; the break remains UNCONDITIONAL and executes after the gate, so termination never depends on the warning. UNTOUCHED as instructed: round-7 placement (the zero-candidate rescan at :954 still precedes the cap check at :982), MAX_HEAL_PASSES left at 8 (:893), the guard, the predicate, the deferral logic and the self-healing subscription. MANAGER INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION on the static tree with all workers stopped: gate 6/6 PASS exit 0 and tsc --noEmit exit 0 (the gate is BLIND to this finding), and the manager confirmed by reading the source that MAX_HEAL_PASSES is unchanged at 8, the zero-candidate break at :954 still precedes the cap check at :982, and the stillClearable gate exists at :997-1003 guarding the warn at :1005. WORKER EVIDENCE the manager reviewed but did not re-run, stated plainly as worker claims: an instrumented single-instance probe (with a module-evaluated-once assertion addressing the confirmed two-instance hazard) shows across arms N=1..8 that warn occurs IFF a stale marker genuinely remains - N=7 gives 8 passes, exit cap, X healed to false, LEGAL kept true, ZERO warnings while an unbounded pathological writer still stops at 8 passes with 1 warning and X genuinely true; and a decisive before/after where the reviewer own probe r8-legal-marker-warn.mjs now exits 0 against this candidate and exit 1 (one false alarm at N=7) against a behaviour-equivalent pre-fix baseline the worker rebuilt in %TEMP%. All 13 required regression probes returned their expected verdicts (guard2 12/12, batch-chain 15/15, and not-reproduced or not-a-permanent-lock throughout, including both undo probes after the documented fixture bugs were fixed in the worker own copies). ONE FIXTURE DEFECT flagged honestly by the worker and NOT a regression: five cap probes (r7-cap, r7-cap-armN, r7-cap-arm8, r8-armN, r8-cap-hard400) each end with one FAIL in section D asserting a legal marker is preserved, because their seed() never sets the canvas copy to true so the assertion is unsatisfiable; the worker proved it is pre-existing by running all five against the pre-fix baseline with an identical single FAIL. The manager records this as a worker claim. NO independent review of THIS candidate has been performed yet and none is claimed; a fresh reviewer is the next step, and the manager notes that eight review rounds have all failed with no PASS while the findings have narrowed from mechanism-level (rounds 1-4) to potential-hazard and prose-level (rounds 5-8), with round 8 down to this single diagnostic-accuracy item.
